# Support for Sandbox Users

Source: https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/support-for-sandbox-users
Documentation version: 6.20.0
Retrieved: 2026-09-08T23:28:48+00:00

## Developer Community

Whether you're a developer who is integrating with Webex Connect APIs and webhooks, or a business user who is using Webex Connect Templates, Visual Flow Builder or Reporting features, engage and network with Webex Connect developer community by visiting Webex Connect [Developer forum](https://community.cisco.com/t5/imiconnect/bd-p/connect).



![Screenshot of the Developer Community portal homepage](https://files.readme.io/6799d48-Screenshot_2021-10-21_at_11.49.13_AM.png)




As an Webex Connect developer community member, you can raise questions, share your knowledge of Webex Connect with others users, sign-up for our upcoming events and webinars and do more.

## Webex Connect Sandbox Status

Visit [Webex Connect status page](https://status.webexcpaas.com/) for real-time status information on Webex Connect Developer Sandbox platform and messaging services.

## Key Resources

- If you're a developer looking to integrate with Webex Connect messaging or voice APIs for embedding communication capabilities with your app, you can refer to **[Webex Connect Developer Sandbox Specific API Reference](https://developers.imiconnect.io/reference#sandbox-apis-overview)**.

- Additionally, you can [download ](https://elements.getpostman.com/redirect?entityId=17978514-bfdbe72f-d536-47bb-b935-651033166c0c&entityType=collection)**Postman Collection** for Developer Sandbox Specific APIs.

- If you're looking for information on Webex Connect visual flow builder, refer to the [Flows](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/flows) section.
